answer: The rule groups identities by their behavioural signature and applies the penalty to the whole group at once. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The garden is the collateral at risk, the zephyr the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the glacier the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many zephyr groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the garden into smaller, individually useless stakes.
